seed_handling: model, numpy and Python seeds are set per run after deterministic noise=0 train data creation; CUDA determinism is not enforced
target_context: for 31 of 32 bytes, prior bytes of the same target digest are in context; the first byte begins after a complete previous digest
target_definition: next byte in concatenated SHA-256 digest stream

training_data.nonce_policy: start=i mod TRAIN_NUM_NONCES then increment by one
